title: Basic Electrical Training
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Basic Electrical Training - Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Perform typical estimations for technical applications based on known formulas, field measurements, establishing proportions, or other numerical relationships used in practical situations in the workplace.

Identify electrical devices in a panel or an electrical schematic, their technological characteristics and ratings, and, following electrical safety procedures, build simple control circuits or replace defective parts.

Following electrical safety procedures, perform basic testing such as measuring voltage or doing continuity tests to assist technicians in troubleshooting procedures on electrical circuits or electro-mechanical systems.

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (e.g., ELTEC322); these match closed-list codes ELTEC 322, ELTEC 320, ELTEC 223 and ELTEC 265.
